description: Construct a Reuleaux triangle in GeoGebra. Start by creating three vertices of an equilateral triangle at specific coordinates: A = (0, 0), B = (4, 0), and C = (2, 2*sqrt(3)). Then, use the Circular Arc tool (or command) to construct the three boundary arcs. Each arc must connect two vertices and be centered at the third vertex (e.g., arc connecting B and C is centered at A). Finally, add a text annotation containing the phrase 'constant width' to the view. Save your construction as 'reuleaux_triangle.ggb' in ~/Documents/GeoGebra/projects/.
